subject: broker
message: The server "broker" declares no security scheme, so the document says nothing about how a client proves who it is when it connects.
basis: A declaration of which security schemes can be used with this server.
fix: Add the scheme (or the alternatives) that a client has to satisfy to connect, under security of the server.

subject: broker
message: The server "broker" uses the plain protocol amqp, and the specification lists amqps for the same protocol. Messages, and the credentials that go with them, can be read and changed on the way.
basis: Supported protocol include, but are not limited to: amqp, amqps, http, https, ibmmq, jms, kafka, kafka-secure, anypointmq, mqtt, secure-mqtt, solace, stomp, stomps, ws, wss, mercure, googlepubsub, pulsar.
fix: Use amqps (TLS) for this server, and keep amqp for a broker on the local machine only.

subject: feedKey
message: The security scheme "feedKey" sends an API key in the query. A key in a URL is shown and logged in many places.
basis: The location of the API key. Valid values are "user" and "password" for apiKey and "query", "header" or "cookie" for httpApiKey. It is therefore unwise to include information within a URI that is sensitive, personally identifiable, or a risk to disclose.
fix: Send the key in a header (in: header) instead.

subject: OrderCancelled
message: The message "OrderCancelled" has no payload schema, so a receiver cannot validate what it gets and a sender cannot tell what it may send.
basis: Definition of the message payload. A message MAY contain a payload and MAY also contain headers.
fix: Add a payload with a schema (type, properties and required).

subject: StatusReply
message: The message "StatusReply" is a reply message of the request/reply operation "askOrderStatus" and has no correlationId, so the reply cannot be matched to its request.
basis: Definition of the correlation ID used for message tracing or matching. If an operation implements the request/reply pattern, the reply object represents the response message.
fix: Add a correlationId with a location (for example $message.header#/correlationId) to the request and to the reply message.

subject: StatusRequest
message: The message "StatusRequest" is a request message of the request/reply operation "askOrderStatus" and has no correlationId, so the reply cannot be matched to its request.
basis: Definition of the correlation ID used for message tracing or matching. If an operation implements the request/reply pattern, the reply object represents the response message.
fix: Add a correlationId with a location (for example $message.header#/correlationId) to the request and to the reply message.

subject: auditTrail
message: The channel "auditTrail" is not used by any operation of this application, so nothing says who sends to it or receives from it.
basis: Holds a dictionary with all the operations this application MUST implement. Sender applications send messages to channels and receiver applications receive messages from channels.
fix: Add an operation that uses the channel, or remove the channel.

subject: OrderPlaced
message: The payload schema of the message "OrderPlaced" lists 2 properties and no required list, so a message with none of them is valid.
basis: The AsyncAPI Schema Object is a JSON Schema vocabulary which extends JSON Schema Core and Validation vocabularies.
fix: List the properties that every message has under required.

subject: OrderCancelled
message: The message "OrderCancelled" has neither a description nor a summary.
basis: A verbose explanation of the message.
fix: Say in a sentence what the message means and when it is sent.
